title: Segregation Monotonicity and the Measurement of Inequality in Social Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.17807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces segregation monotonicity as a criterion for evaluating measures of inequality in social networks. A network inequality measure satisfies segregation monotonicity if, holding the distribution of income fixed, it weakly increases as the network becomes more segregated according to a specified transformation of network architecture. I investigate this property using a class of level-$k$ star networks that represent increasing social segregation in the following sense: relatively poorer individuals become increasingly isolated from one another and their social comparisons become increasingly concentrated among richer individuals. I show that a relative deprivation-based measure of inequality, which aggregates comparisons with richer network neighbors, satisfies segregation monotonicity. translated_title: 隔离单调性与社会网络中不平等的度量
translated_abstract: 本文引入隔离单调性作为评估社会网络不平等度量的一项标准。如果在收入分布保持不变的情况下，一种网络不平等度量随着网络按照特定的结构转换变得更加隔离而弱增加，那么该度量就满足隔离单调性。我利用一类level-k星型网络来研究这一性质，这类网络代表日益加深的社会隔离，其含义是：相对较贫穷的个体彼此之间日益孤立，他们的社会比较日益集中在较富裕的个体之间。我证明了基于相对剥夺感的不平等度量——即汇总个体与更富裕网络邻居的比较——满足隔离单调性。相比之下，基于总体经验的度量——即汇总所有网络邻居之间的绝对收入差异——通常不满足这一性质。
tldr: 本文提出“隔离单调性”作为评估社会网络不平等度量的新标准，并证明基于相对剥夺感的度量满足该性质，而基于总体经验的度量则通常不满足。
